caveat: This is the classifier judging measured by the model that wrote it, not an independent expert, and it is measured from the same text the classifier reads. Treat it as a floor on obvious errors, not as a certified accuracy. Two of the first judgements were themselves wrong -- tenders with generic titles like 'Revenue Fund 2026-27' were tagged from the work description, which is not visible in the title -- so the figure rose from 75% to 80% on checking.
